en.content:
White and Red Swordsman’s Red Energy Sword Combo

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
[PR] Topview Film Studio
Since a variety of features have been added, here’s an introduction to some of them
@topviewAIJP #TopviewAI #AIVideo

When you select a feature in Film Studio, it moves to Canvas in a state where that feature can be used from this UI!

The attached video was created using the following steps (Seedance 2.0):
1. Upload the video to Canvas, analyze it (I look at the analysis results with a focus on how it is trying to express the space between frames), and create a prompt. (If you want to create a motion prompt, it’s better to keep the background simple.)
2. Provide an image and have the prompt revised for the provided character, then generate the video.
3. Watch the video and point out the parts you want changed.
4. Finish with clip editing, upscaling, and other refinements.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] Revised version

If you copy from the one linked to the video generation button, it ends up as something like “@char_1,” so if you’re copying it for reuse, it seems better not to use that one.

prompt:
Scene Header: Day · Interior · White geometric space env_1 · monochrome minimalist · high-key diffuse light · red energy accent

0.0-1.5s: White and Red Swordsman char_1 assumes a stance and performs a right-diagonal downward slash (one-handed, agile, red energy blade leaves a trail)

1.5-2.5s: A horizontal sweep with a forward step (char_1 advances 2-3m, white long hair and Chinese dress flowing)

2.5-4.0s: An upward slash into a launching jump (char_1 rises, one-handed small sword draws a red vertical arc from bottom to top)

4.0-7.0s: Midair forward-rotation buzzsaw multi-hit attack (char_1 spins rapidly 5-6 times, one-handed sword held close to the body in fast multiple rotations, red spiral motion-blur trails, pillars in the white geometric space env_1 streak past with the rotating viewpoint)

7.0-9.0s: Vertical slam landing (char_1 swings the one-handed sword downward and lands, stabbing into the ground, shockwave and orange sparks erupt, vibrations ripple through the white geometric space env_1)

9.0-10.5s: Low sweep (char_1 slides forward in a low stance, the one-handed sword sweeps horizontally just above the ground, leaving a red semicircular trail)

10.5-12.0s: Large horizontal slash with shockwave (char_1 rises and performs a wide horizontal slash, a red shockwave blasts forward, lingering shockwave aftereffects in the white geometric space env_1)

12.0-14.0s: Sheath and hold position (char_1 returns the one-handed small sword to a ready stance and stands still upright, the quiet of the white geometric space env_1 returns)

Important direction notes:
- Keep the gaps between attacks almost zero; the sequence should flow continuously at a high-speed rhythm
- char_1 must always be moving forward (dash, step, slide); standing still in place is forbidden
- Agile handling of the one-handed small sword (heavy movements like a two-handed greatsword are forbidden)
- A multi-hit combo feel (each attack should not be clearly separated, but connected in a flowing sequence)
- The red energy blade trail should be a high-speed, semi-transparent motion blur

SFX: sword whooshes (rapid continuous) + landing impact sound + crackling sparks + shockwave roar

Visual style direction: monochrome minimalist environment with red energy accent, high-key diffuse lighting, cel-shaded 3D anime aesthetic, translucent red arc motion trails for energy blade trajectory (continuous flowing trails, not discrete arcs), orange spark particles and red light particles on impact, extremely fast and precise combat choreography with zero pauses between attacks, constant forward momentum.

prompt:
Scene Header: Day · Interior · 白の幾何学空間 env_1 · monochrome minimalist · high-key diffuse light · red energy accent

0.0-1.5s: 白紅剣士 char_1 adopta una postura y ejecuta un corte diagonal descendente hacia la derecha (a una mano, ágil, la espada de energía roja deja una estela)

1.5-2.5s: barrido lateral con paso hacia delante (char_1 avanza 2-3 m, su largo cabello blanco y su vestido chino se ondulan)

2.5-4.0s: corte ascendente para lanzar un salto (char_1 asciende, la pequeña espada de una mano dibuja un arco vertical rojo de abajo arriba)

4.0-7.0s: ataque múltiple en giro frontal en el aire tipo buzzsaw (char_1 da 5-6 giros rápidos, la espada de una mano va pegada al cuerpo en rotaciones veloces, con motion blur y una estela espiral roja; las columnas del espacio geométrico blanco env_1 se deslizan con la perspectiva giratoria)

7.0-9.0s: golpe vertical descendente con aterrizaje (char_1 baja la espada de una mano y aterriza, la clava en el suelo, se generan una onda de choque y chispas naranjas, vibración en el espacio geométrico blanco env_1)

9.0-10.5s: barrido bajo (char_1 avanza deslizándose en una postura baja, la espada de una mano gira horizontalmente rozando el suelo, con una estela de arco semicircular rojo)

10.5-12.0s: gran barrido lateral con onda de choque (char_1, al incorporarse, ejecuta un amplio barrido lateral con la espada de una mano, una onda de choque roja se proyecta hacia delante, con el eco visual de la onda en el espacio geométrico blanco env_1)

12.0-14.0s: envaina y espera (char_1 vuelve a la postura con la pequeña espada de una mano y permanece inmóvil en posición erguida, regresa la quietud del espacio geométrico blanco env_1)

Indicaciones importantes de puesta en escena:
- El intervalo entre cada ataque es casi cero; fluye en un ritmo rápido y continuo
- char_1 avanza siempre hacia delante (dash, step, slide); está prohibido quedarse quieto en el mismo sitio
- Manejo ágil de la pequeña espada de una mano (prohibidos los movimientos pesados como los de una gran espada a dos manos)
- Sensación de combo encadenado con múltiples impactos (cada ataque no debe separarse claramente, sino conectarse de forma fluida)
- La estela de la espada de energía roja debe ser un motion blur semitransparente que permanece a alta velocidad

SFX: sonido de corte del viento de la espada (rápido y continuo) + impacto del aterrizaje + sonido de chispas al estallar + rugido de la onda de choque

Visual style direction: monochrome minimalist environment with red energy accent, high-key diffuse lighting, cel-shaded 3D anime aesthetic, translucent red arc motion trails for energy blade trajectory (continuous flowing trails, not discrete arcs), orange spark particles and red light particles on impact, extremely fast and precise combat choreography with zero pauses between attacks, constant forward momentum.

2.5-4.0s: coup remontant suivi d’un saut propulsé vers le haut (char_1 s’élève, la petite épée à une main trace un arc vertical rouge de bas en haut)

4.0-7.0s: attaque multiple en rotation avant dans les airs, type buzzsaw (char_1 effectue 5 à 6 rotations rapides, l’épée à une main reste près du corps dans une rotation rapide continue, traînées de motion blur rouges en spirale, les colonnes de 白の幾何学空間 env_1 défilent avec le point de vue en rotation)

7.0-9.0s: frappe verticale vers le bas et atterrissage (char_1 abat l’épée à une main en descendant et atterrit, la lame se plante dans le sol, une onde de choc et des étincelles orange apparaissent, vibrations dans 白の幾何学空間 env_1)

9.0-10.5s: balayage bas (char_1 avance en glissant en position basse, l’épée à une main tourne horizontalement au ras du sol, traînée en demi-arc rouge)

10.5-12.0s: grand balayage horizontal avec onde de choc (char_1, en se relevant, effectue un large balayage horizontal avec l’épée à une main, une onde de choc rouge se projette vers l’avant, rémanence de l’onde de choc dans 白の幾何学空間 env_1)

12.0-14.0s: rengaine et attente (char_1 remet la petite épée à une main en position de garde et reste immobile en posture droite, le calme revient dans 白の幾何学空間 env_1)

Instructions de mise en scène importantes:
- L’intervalle entre chaque attaque est presque nul, enchaînement fluide à un rythme très rapide
- char_1 avance toujours vers l’avant (dash, pas, glissade) ; il est interdit de rester sur place
- Maniement agile de la petite épée à une main (les mouvements lourds de grande épée à deux mains sont interdits)

- Les traînées de la lame d’énergie rouge doivent être des motion blur semi-transparentes, laissées à grande vitesse

SFX: bruit de vent tranché par l’épée (série rapide continue) + bruit d’impact à l’atterrissage + crépitement des étincelles + grondement de l’onde de choc

9.0-10.5s: 下段払い（char_1 が低姿勢スライドで前進、片手剣が地面すれすれを水平に旋回、赤い半円弧のトレイル）

- 한 손 소형 검의 민첩한 다루기(양손 대검처럼 무거운 움직임은 금지)
- 다단 히트의 연격감(각 공격이 명확히 분리되지 않고, 흐르듯 이어짐)
- 붉은 에너지 블레이드의 궤적은 고속으로 남는 반투명 모션 블러

SFX: 검의 바람 가르는 소리(고속 연속) + 착지 충격음 + 불꽃이 튀는 소리 + 충격파의 굉음
